convention_rule: Position of the single green-lit element among otherwise dark repeated elements encodes candidate index (numeric ID order); no prior examples given, so zero-shot guess.
basis: A: five posts, only the 3rd from left carries a green lantern. B: three parallel stepping-stone rows, only the middle row glows green. Both suggest index 3 / middle; P3 is also the middle of non-client-correct IDs P2,P3,P4 (client-correct is P1).
